caption: An oblique top-down view shows two optical discs lying flat side by side on a dark wood-grain desk. The left disc carries a warm golden iridescent sheen broken by a thin dark radial slit from its empty hub toward the lower edge, while the right disc reflects brighter silvery-white light with greenish tints near its top. Both hubs sit unclamped, and a few white specks of debris dot the desk at left and bottom. Out-of-focus objects line the upper edge of the frame, including a pinkish wire form, a row of small cases, and a dark rounded shape at right. Overhead lighting produces the rainbow reflections across the disc surfaces. Throughout the excerpt the discs hold their positions and the reflection patterns stay fixed, with nothing entering or disturbing the scene.
